messages:
maya_cs: Hey team — quick sync on Sentinel (customer) private/VPC deploy. Target go-live Friday EOD. Need final signoffs on: networking, IAM, KMS, and audit logs. Brief status + blockers?

raj_netops: Routing and subnets are in place, ASGs behind internal NLBs. Still verifying NAT gateway failover in 2nd AZ. Saw one rejected route during smoke: 10.12.0.0/16 -> blackhole on vpc-rtb-3.

emma_security: KMS key policy currently blocks cross-account decrypt for the connector role. Customer's infra team wants us to manage key usage via our KMS proxy. Need explicit kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey perms for role redwood-sentinel-role.

ryan_se: Customer confirmed their side finished proxy config yesterday. They asked about audit log latency — they want near-real-time (under 30s) in their SIEM. We currently batch logs every minute; can tighten to 15s for them but that will add egress cost.

deploy-bot: build/deploy/sentinel-private v2.14: ✅ passed all e2e checks — staging -> preprod promotion queued.

maya_cs: Good — two immediate questions: (1) can we update KMS policy today and get customer sign-off? (2) who owns the route fix and cutover window? Also need confirmation on audit log retention window (default 30d vs requested 90d).

raj_netops: I'll take the route fix. Plan: rotate the route table on preprod, run smoke: `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-abc123 --destination-cidr-block 10.12.0.0/16 --gateway-id igw-zzz` then validate connectivity with `nc -vz internal-nlb:443`. Can do cutover Fri 16:00-17:00 PT.

emma_security: I can push the KMS policy change. Suggested policy snippet for redwood-sentinel-role (customer-approved):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-sentinel-role"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Add note: set KeyPolicy to require `kms:Encrypt`/`Decrypt` only from our connector principal and customer's audit account.

ryan_se: I'll coordinate the customer sign-off call. Can we target Thu 10:30 PT for a 15m window to confirm KMS change and run a quick log smoke? I'll invite their infra lead + security.

nina_acc: From renewal perspective: Sentinel team said they will be more comfortable renewing if we commit to 99.9% private-region uptime and include 90d audit retention (they view logs as compliance evidence). We can offer 90d as an add-on, but they pushed back on extra cost — possible negotiation point.

maya_cs: Noted. Action items: (1) raj_netops — fix route + lead Fri cutover (owner: raj_netops). (2) emma_security — apply KMS policy and share PR for customer review (owner: emma_security). (3) ryan_se — run Thu 10:30 sign-off call and verify audit latency with 15s config (owner: ryan_se). (4) nina_acc — handle renewal messaging and list concessions we can offer (owner: nina_acc). Please confirm ETA in thread. :white_check_mark:

raj_netops: Confirmed. Route fix by Thu 15:00 PT for preprod smoke; cutover Fri 16:00-17:00 PT.

emma_security: I'll open a KMS policy PR by Thu 08:30 PT and add the key rotation notes. I'll also propose audit log retention change to 90d as config flag (impact: +estimated $120/mo egress for this customer).

ryan_se: I sent the invite to customer infra + security. Will run the smoke during the call and confirm <30s latency. If we need 15s, I'll toggle log batching to 15s during the call.

nina_acc: I'll prepare renewal talking points and quantify the retention cost vs. compliance benefit. Will loop in legal for SLA language on private-region uptime. Target internal prep Fri 09:00 PT.

maya_cs: Great — I'll update the customer-facing runbook and post cutover checklist here after the Thu call. Thanks all :sparkles:

(edited) maya_cs: Added note — include an audit log sample doc for customer's security review link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sentinel-audit-sample
